summary.text: Kristen Arrington is a Democratic member of the Florida Senate for District 25, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate's biographical page, Arrington served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024.
Arrington owns a marketing and consulting firm, holds an A.A. from Valencia College, and was born in Holiday, Florida.
